terms.gloss: touch the sky with one’s finger: be supremely happy
terms.grammar: attingō with caelum; digitō, ablative of means
evidence: Cic. Att. 2.1.7 (Lewis & Short), s.v. caelum: “to be extremely fortunate”

terms.gloss: be in heaven, be very happy
evidence: Cic. Att. 2.9.1: in caelō sum (Lewis & Short), s.v. caelum

sources: Lewis & Short: caelum · Lewis & Short: digitus · Lewis & Short: attingo
